The change in `abstract.py` explicitly converts snapshots to `pd.Index(..., tupleize_cols=False, name="snapshot")` whenever linopy uses v1 semantics, without consulting `optimization.model_snapshot_index`. Thus, for a network with MultiIndex snapshots and the option set to `"auto"` or `"flat"`, it forces flat tuple labels before optimisation rather than passing the MultiIndex that `SnapshotWindow.build` accepts and converts itself.
